AI providers

Use my relay as the AI server
Speech and text go to your relay, which calls the AI provider with the key stored on it. The provider key then stays on the relay and is not needed here. Fill in the relay address and token under Privacy (Sync voice notes with my relay)
Stored on this phone, not encrypted. A server of your own may need no key. Plain http works only for this phone, your local network and Tailscale.
Different server for voice or cleanup
For example Whisper on one machine and Ollama on another. Each server gets only its own key

Voice & audio

Language
Auto can switch on short phrases
AI cleanup
Removes fillers, fixes punctuation, applies corrections
Skip AI cleanup for phrases shorter than N words
Short phrases are typed as spoken, which is faster. 1 cleans up everything (1 to 20)

Privacy

What leaves this phone: your audio and its transcript go to your voice server, and the cleanup text goes to your cleanup server (both through your relay when it is the AI server). Voice notes are kept in this phone's note store and send no app name; with sync on, their text also goes to your relay. Vox has no analytics and no server of its own.

Keep dictation history
Saves what you dictate on this phone, not encrypted. Off saves nothing
Sync voice notes with my relay
Keeps your voice notes the same on your phone and PCs through a relay you run yourself (a small server, for example on a Raspberry Pi, reached over Tailscale). While on, the relay receives the full text, raw transcript, tags and device name of each voice note, and your About you text, dictionary, people, default style, cleanup switch and language. Needs its address and token
Stored on this phone, not encrypted. Plain http works only for this phone, your local network and Tailscale.
Sent to the relay and shown on its page and on the notes made here. Blank uses the phone model.
Also share my provider settings and API keys
Off by default. When on, the AI provider, models and API keys are copied to your other devices through the relay, so anyone with the relay token can read them. Turning it off removes them from the relay
About you
Added to every cleanup request, so it goes to your cleanup server. While sync is on it is also copied to your relay. Edit it on the Dictionary tab

An ongoing notification with a Record note button. Needs no extra permission
